lines.lyric_translation: Winter is blowing again
I wonder how much time has passed
Everything has changed except for me
I’m getting lonelier to the point it hurts
I, who still miss you
Am still standing in the same place
Reminiscing about our old days
I close my eyes and remember
The days are getting shorter, and the nights are getting longer

lines.lyric: Shirin mam wie eoreum gateun ge noganne
lines.lyric_hangul: 시린 맘 위에 얼음 같은 게 녹았네
lines.lyric_translation: On my cold and sore heart, something icy has melted
After repeating to freeze and melt
My heart has lost its warmth from mere regrets

lines.lyric: We are like movie, makhil deuthae sumi
lines.lyric_hangul: We are like movie 막힐 듯해 숨이
lines.lyric_translation: We are like movie, I feel out of breath
Talking about the old days makes me toss and turn again

lines.lyric: Eojjeol su eoptta hamyeonseodo ne heunjeoge meomchit
lines.lyric_hangul: 어쩔 수 없다 하면서도 네 흔적에 멈칫
lines.lyric_translation: While I know there’s nothing I can do,
I’m reminded once again as I hesitate after seeing pieces of you
Winter Falls, the snow falls
Purer than anything
Falls, I’ll try to erase everything about you
That still remains with me

lines.lyric: I loved you loved you loved you
lines.lyric_hangul: I loved you, loved you, loved you
lines.lyric_translation: I loved you loved you loved you

lines.lyric: Neodo geuraetteut loved you loved you loved you
lines.lyric_hangul: 너도 그랬듯 loved you, loved you, loved you
lines.lyric_translation: As you did, loved you loved you loved you
Again, the snow Falls
We fall apart
Winter Falls oh
Winter Falls oh
Please fall before I fall

Yeah, I’ll be okay
That’s enough now
I don’t care, go away
I search for you in my memory (find you)

lines.lyric: Geu son jabgo geuttae georeoga (yeah yeah)
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 손 잡고 그때 걸어가 (yeah, yeah)
lines.lyric_translation: We were holding hands while walking back then (yeah yeah)
It was a warm winter
Everything was beautiful back then

lines.lyric: Joyonghan haneul arae sumeo mameul modu biweo geudael
lines.lyric_hangul: 조용한 하늘 아래 숨어 맘을 모두 비워 그댈
lines.lyric_translation: Hiding under the silent sky, I try to empty my mind

lines.lyric: Inneun geotboda mireonaeneun ge geunama shwiweo geurae
lines.lyric_hangul: 잊는 것보다 밀어내는 게 그나마 쉬워 그래
lines.lyric_translation: Because it’s easier to push you away rather than to erase you

lines.lyric: Geuttaega geuriun geonji, geudaega geuriun geonji
lines.lyric_hangul: 그때가 그리운 건지, 그대가 그리운 건지
lines.lyric_translation: Whether it’s the old days that I miss, or it’s you that I miss

lines.lyric: Domuji al su eomneun naye ireum moreul miryeondeuri
lines.lyric_hangul: 도무지 알 수 없는 나의 이름 모를 미련들이
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t know why but I still have lingering feelings for you

lines.lyric: Gwaenhi sen cheogeul haebwado naman useubge dwae
lines.lyric_hangul: 괜히 센 척을 해봐도 나만 우습게 돼
lines.lyric_translation: Even if I pretend to be strong, it only makes me look funny

lines.lyric: Sagyejeori myeot beon jinaya gwaenchanajilkka yeah
lines.lyric_hangul: 사계절이 몇 번 지나야 괜찮아질까 yeah
lines.lyric_translation: How many years will it take for me to be okay yeah
It’s only going to hurt, no matter how deep I dig into my memory,
I’ll be the one left scarred and feeling small
Winter Falls, the snow falls
Purer than anything
Falls, I’ll try to erase everything about you
That still remains with me

lines.lyric: Gin kkumeul kkuda ireonan geot gata
lines.lyric_hangul: 긴 꿈을 꾸다 일어난 것 같아
lines.lyric_translation: I feel like I woke up from a long dream
The snow is falling and time is drifting away

lines.lyric: Neol pumgo itteon gyejeori dashi olkka
lines.lyric_hangul: 널 품고 있던 계절이 다시 올까
lines.lyric_translation: Will the season when I held you in my arms ever return again?
I have to let you go now, but it’s too hard
Winter Falls, the snow falls
Purer than anything
Falls, I’ll try to erase everything about you
That still remains with me
